  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it must
            be one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Used to compose the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility with the flat address form. On read this holds the
            composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an
            'addressLine2' was supplied. Optional on create when structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address'
            when supplied; normalized on create with the same rules as
            'address' (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). When supplied it is normalized
            with the same rules as 'addressLine1' and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits; this
            E.164 value is stored and returned. For example '0412 345 678' is
            stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be
            exactly four digits and, when the city has a known region (Sydney
            -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), fall within that
            region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD
            4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional;
            when supplied it is stored and returned, and drives the derived
            'ageBand' (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and postcode (same household); the new owner
            is then created as a declared household member and is not flagged as
            a possible duplicate. Without it a second owner in the same household
            is rejected with 409. Write-only flag used only on create; it is
            never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's grouped, version-2 identifiers. Each identifier is derived
        by the version-2 algorithm, which mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag so
        that no value produced under version 1 is produced again. These are the
        machine identifiers only; the plain, unversioned region code still
        surfaces separately via the user-facing 'locality' field.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the version-2 region code
            (the region derived from the postcode, falling back to a
            city-to-region table, else 'UNKNOWN', with the fixed 'V2' version
            tag mixed in), FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of
            the business-day-adjusted registration date, HASH8 is the first 8
            upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized
            E.164 telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single
            Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
            Assigned at creation; carries no sequence number (a collision is
            de-duplicated with a '-<n>' suffix).
          type: string
          readOnly: true
          example: 'NSWV2271A2B3C4D5'
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable shared identifier derived deterministically from the
            owner's last name and postcode with the fixed 'V2' version tag mixed
            in (the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
            normalized last name, the postcode and the 'V2' tag). It is assigned
            to every owner automatically, so all owners with the same last name
            and postcode share the same value.
          type: string
          readOnly: true
          example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case SHA-256
            hex (64 characters) of the normalized E.164 telephone, the
            lower-cased email (or empty when none), the American Soundex code of
            the last name and the fixed 'V2' version tag, joined with '|'. A
            create is rejected with 409 when a new owner's whole identity key
            equals an existing owner's (ignoring owners flagged deleted);
            because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same
            household with different telephones have different keys and are both
            allowed (the second is instead flagged as a possible duplicate).
          type: string
          readOnly: true
          example: '3b1f8c...'
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title, a
                single space, and the last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'). When no
                title was supplied it is just the last name.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is displayed as '+61 412 345 678'. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The identity API version carried by this response. Always 2: the
                owner's identifiers are derived by the version-2 algorithm and
                grouped under the 'identity' object.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's grouped, version-2 identifiers (memberId,
                householdId and identityKey). Replaces the former top-level
                identifier fields.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year (which starts on 1 July) of the
                business-day-adjusted registration date. A registration on or
                after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending in the following
                calendar year. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY27'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier derived deterministically from the
                owner's last name and postcode (the first 12 hex characters of
                the SHA-256 digest of the normalized last name and the postcode).
                It is assigned to every owner automatically, so all owners with
                the same last name and postcode share the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case
                SHA-256 hex (64 characters) of the normalized E.164 telephone,
                the lower-cased email (or empty when none), and the American
                Soundex code of the last name, joined with '|'. A create is
                rejected with 409 when a new owner's whole identity key equals an
                existing owner's (ignoring owners flagged deleted); because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household
                with different telephones have different keys and are both
                allowed (the second is instead flagged as a possible duplicate).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '3b1f8c...'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation and
                returned on read.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's derived membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when
                an email address is present; add 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 when the owner belongs to
                a household of 3 or more; add 3 when the owner's tenure is at
                least one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start 1 July). A
                newly created owner has zero tenure, so a new owner
                with an email and no namesakes in a single-member household
                scores 3 points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's derived membership level, a number from 1 to 4
                mapped from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the leading '<REGION>' segment of
                the memberId (everything before its trailing FY, HASH8 and CHK
                segments). The region is derived from the postcode at creation
                (falling back to a fixed city-to-region table, else 'UNKNOWN'),
                so the locality moves with the owner's region-and-hash identity.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time and
                formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived at read time from the
                locality/region via a fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane. Absent when the region resolves to
                no entry in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from the birthDate
                relative to the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18,
                'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when
                no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80
                owners had already been created for the current day; otherwise
                false. Assigned at creation and returned on read.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, its city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the per-city capacity
                limit of 50); otherwise false. Assigned at creation and returned
                on read.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                (identity-key) duplicate yet shared an existing owner's last name
                and postcode while carrying a different telephone; otherwise
                false. Assigned at creation and returned on read.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of (the owner whose last name and postcode it shares).
                Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual risk review, derived at
                read time as the logical OR of three conditions: the owner is a
                possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the email
                domain is disposable-adjacent (a dot-separated label of the
                email domain matches the second-level label of a known
                disposable-email provider, e.g. 'mailinator' in
                'sub.mailinator.com' or 'mailinator.net'), or the city is over
                its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true, i.e. the city held
                at least 40 owners when this owner was created). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false. DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and retains the
                record (the owner is still returned on read). Owners flagged
                deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and
                identity checks.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI path of this owner resource, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' where <id> is the owner's id. Derived at
                read time.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it must
            be one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Used to compose the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility with the flat address form. On read this holds the
            composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an
            'addressLine2' was supplied. Optional on create when structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address'
            when supplied; normalized on create with the same rules as
            'address' (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). When supplied it is normalized
            with the same rules as 'addressLine1' and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits; this
            E.164 value is stored and returned. For example '0412 345 678' is
            stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be
            exactly four digits and, when the city has a known region (Sydney
            -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), fall within that
            region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD
            4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional;
            when supplied it is stored and returned, and drives the derived
            'ageBand' (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and postcode (same household); the new owner
            is then created as a declared household member and is not flagged as
            a possible duplicate. Without it a second owner in the same household
            is rejected with 409. Write-only flag used only on create; it is
            never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's grouped, version-2 identifiers. Each identifier is derived
        by the version-2 algorithm, which mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag so
        that no value produced under version 1 is produced again. These are the
        machine identifiers only; the plain, unversioned region code still
        surfaces separately via the user-facing 'locality' field.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the version-2 region code
            (the region derived from the postcode, falling back to a
            city-to-region table, else 'UNKNOWN', with the fixed 'V2' version
            tag mixed in), FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of
            the business-day-adjusted registration date, HASH8 is the first 8
            upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized
            E.164 telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single
            Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
            Assigned at creation; carries no sequence number (a collision is
            de-duplicated with a '-<n>' suffix).
          type: string
          readOnly: true
          example: 'NSWV2271A2B3C4D5'
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable shared identifier derived deterministically from the
            owner's last name and postcode with the fixed 'V2' version tag mixed
            in (the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
            normalized last name, the postcode and the 'V2' tag). It is assigned
            to every owner automatically, so all owners with the same last name
            and postcode share the same value.
          type: string
          readOnly: true
          example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case SHA-256
            hex (64 characters) of the normalized E.164 telephone, the
            lower-cased email (or empty when none), the American Soundex code of
            the last name and the fixed 'V2' version tag, joined with '|'. A
            create is rejected with 409 when a new owner's whole identity key
            equals an existing owner's (ignoring owners flagged deleted);
            because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same
            household with different telephones have different keys and are both
            allowed (the second is instead flagged as a possible duplicate).
          type: string
          readOnly: true
          example: '3b1f8c...'
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title, a
                single space, and the last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'). When no
                title was supplied it is just the last name.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is displayed as '+61 412 345 678'. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The identity API version carried by this response. Always 2: the
                owner's identifiers are derived by the version-2 algorithm and
                grouped under the 'identity' object.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's grouped, version-2 identifiers (memberId,
                householdId and identityKey). Replaces the former top-level
                identifier fields.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:

* Derives the stable version-2 household identifier shared by all owners with the same last name and
     * postcode. The value is deterministic (the first 12 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256
     * digest of the normalized last name, the postcode and the fixed
     * {@link IdentityKeyUtils#IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG version tag}, joined with {@code '|'}), so every owner
     * in the same household is assigned an identical identifier regardless of creation order and
     * without any explicit linking. Mixing in the version tag means no household id produced under
     * version 1 is produced again.
     *
     * @param lastName the owner's last name
     * @param postcode the owner's postcode, possibly {@code null}
     * @return the stable household identifier
     */
    private static String householdIdFor(String lastName, String postcode) {
        String key = normalizeForHousehold(lastName) + "|" + (postcode == null ? "" : postcode)
            + "|" + IdentityKeyUtils.IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG;
        return IdentityKeyUtils.sha256UpperHex(key).substring(0, 12);
    }

## Summary

I released version 2 of the owner identity. The change touches four areas at once, exactly as specified:

**1. Version-2 identity derivation** — introduced a single source of truth, `IdentityKeyUtils.IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG = "V2"`, and mixed it into every identifier:
- **memberId** (`OwnerRestControllerV1.memberIdFor`): the region segment baked into the id is now `regionOf(owner) + "V2"` (e.g. `NSWV2…`). Because the tag is a literal segment, no version-1 member id can recur.
- **householdId** (`ClinicServiceImpl.householdIdFor`): the `V2` tag is now part of the SHA-256 pre-image (`lastName|postcode|V2`).
- **identityKey** (`OwnerMapper.toIdentityKey`): the `V2` tag is now part of the pre-image (`telephone|email|soundex|V2`). Since this is the single source used by the 409 duplicate check too, clients and the check stay consistent.

**2. The owner segment / user-facing region** — `toLocality` now returns the plain region via `regionOf(owner)` instead of extracting it from the (now V2-tagged) memberId. So `locality` stays `NSW`, `timezone` and `ownerSegment`'s derived region use the plain code, and the `V2` tag appears only inside the identifiers. `ownerSegment` is thereby recomputed from the version-2 identity (e.g. `STANDARD_METRO`).

**3. Response shape** — the OpenAPI spec now defines an `OwnerIdentity` schema; `memberId`, `householdId` and `identityKey` moved off the top level into a nested `identity` object, and a top-level integer `apiVersion: 2` was added. `OwnerMapper` maps both via `toIdentity(owner)` and `IDENTITY_API_VERSION`.

**4. Audit schema** — `OwnerCreatedEvent` moved to schema version 2: added `schemaVersion: 2` and an `ownerSegment` field recomputed from the version-2 identity; the controller now passes `ownerDto.getOwnerSegment()`.

Request fields are unchanged. I also removed the now-dead `memberIdRegion` helper and fixed its javadoc references. The one new acceptance test (`coreV2GroupsIdentityAndVersions`) and the build pass.
